crossRefs.note: Hear, you peoples, all of you. Listen, O earth, and all that is therein: and let the Lord Yahweh be witness against…
Then Samuel said to Saul, “Stay, and I will tell you what Yahweh said to me last night.” He said to him, “Say on.”
Hear, and give ear. Don’t be proud, for Yahweh has spoken.
Hear this word that Yahweh has spoken against you, children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out…
Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,
don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go…
Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.
He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:
Hear, heavens, and listen, earth; for Yahweh has spoken: “I have nourished and brought up children and they have…
O earth, earth, earth, hear Yahweh’s word!
You, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, “You mountains of Israel, hear Yahweh’s word.
“ ‘ “But you, mountains of Israel, you shall shoot out your branches, and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for…
He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”
The mountains melt under him, and the valleys split apart, like wax before the fire, like waters that are poured down a…
For there will be a day of Yahweh of Armies for all that is proud and arrogant, and for all that is lifted up; and it…
Again he said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and tell them, ‘You dry bones, hear Yahweh’s word.

translations.web: Listen now to what Yahweh says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.
translations.bsb: Hear now what the LORD says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.
translations.kjv: Hear ye now what the LORD saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.
translations.asv: Hear ye now what Jehovah saith: Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.
